Package com.javiergs.turtle4j

Class RobotCapabilities

java.lang.Object
com.javiergs.turtle4j.RobotCapabilities
public final class RobotCapabilities extends Object
Snapshot of live ROS 2 topic discovery. An advertised topic does not guarantee a healthy publisher, subscriber, or operational robot.

    • fromDiscovery

      public static RobotCapabilities fromDiscovery(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode topicResponse, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode serviceResponse)
      Builds a report from rosapi topic and service responses. Topic recognition uses advertised message types plus conservative name hints; multiple matches remain in extras rather than choosing arbitrarily.
      Parameters:
      topicResponse - rosapi/topics values
      serviceResponse - rosapi/services values
      Returns:
      immutable discovery snapshot
